Instructions for Use
Device description: The Aster Aneurysm Clip is a intracranial aneurysm clip. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
The Aster Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 and 3 Tesla
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 4000 gauss/cm (40 T/m)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Coil Type head transmit/receive coil only
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg ≤ 0.5 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 3.2 W/kg
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 25 mm beyond the implant.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
